label: early original-phase t/c/a/1/p/s/0 input after a u or 2
explanation: Sparse (about 1% of steps), 81% of mass in the original phase, peaking at t=2-3; never fires at t=0 and almost never on the delimiter. Strongest when the current input is t, c, a, 1, p, s or 0 and a u or 2 came just before (prev_tok u/2 has 6-8x lift; the top activations are all u 2 followed by t or c at t=2). Activation is largest when the sequence starts with u 2. The rest of the mass is spread thinly: copy-phase steps (19%, rising at the last recall positions), other input tokens, and contexts without u/2, so neither precision (~0.3) nor recall (~0.4) is high. Does not fire on u or 2 inputs themselves. Magnitude claims beyond the u-2-prefix peak were not checked.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: t=1 & prev_tok=2 (+8.12), t=1 & prev_tok=u (+6.67), t=2 & prev_tok=2 (+4.32), t=3 & prev_tok=2 (+3.65), phase=2 & in_tok=a (+3.61), t=2 & prev_tok=u (+2.85). Lower it: prev2_tok=- (-5.28), out_tok=1 (-3.59), out_tok=0 (-3.25), in_tok=e (-3.20).
